note: WON (Hibernate/JPA, Java — 5th ORM, uncontested out-category). TWO orchestrator fixes: (1) entityNodes filter also reads metadata.attributes.annotations (Java analyzer stores class-level @Entity there, not metadata.annotations) so JPA @Entity classes are recognized; (2) the decorator->relation path derived relTarget from a TypeORM `() => Target` lambda only — JPA names no lambda, the related entity IS the field TYPE, so when relationType is set but no lambda matched, derive target from prop.metadata.type (List<Post>/Set<Post> -> generic arg; bare User -> itself). @OneToMany->1:N, @ManyToOne->N:1.
